#### **Bio** 

I am interested in biostatistics in clinical trials, farmacogenomics, data management, evolution and bioinformatics.

Participant as student of VieRnes de Bioinformática en el LIIGH (bioinformatics fridays at @[LIIGH-UNAM](https://twitter.com/LIIGH_UNAM)) | web page: https://viernesbioinformatica.github.io/ | Github: [ViernesBioinfo2024](https://github.com/EveliaCoss/ViernesBioinfo2024).
